newsitem.title: PERU: Peru consumer prices up 11.7 pct in last 12 mths.
newsitem.headline: Peru consumer prices up 11.7 pct in last 12 mths.

text.p: Peru's consumer prices rose 11.7 percent in the 12 months to the end of September, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Tuesday.
The institute did not give a comparative figure for the 12-month period to September 1995.
Earlier, the INEI announced consumer prices rose 0.32 percent in September, compared with a 0.4 percent rise in the same month last year and a 0.92 percent rise in August.
Accumulated inflation in the first nine months of 1996 was 9.19 percent, up from 7.8 percent in the same period last year, the INEI said.
The institute said medicines and health care services led September's consumer inflation with a 1.4 percent rise, followed by a 0.9 percent increase in the cost of educational materials.
